title: peacekeeping-for-profit-update: UN peacekeeping contributions, military capacity and UN reimbursements by country, 1990-2026
description:
Applies the first condition of Coleman and Nyblade (2018), 'Peacekeeping for profit? The scope and limits of mercenary UN peacekeeping' (Journal of Peace Research 55(6): 726-741, doi:10.1177/0022343318775784), to the 20 largest UN military contributors every December from 2015 to 2025: estimated UN troop-cost payments relative to military spending, and deployments relative to armed forces. Builds on peacekeeping-tracker v1.0.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23752307) for the UN personnel data, which is rebuilt by the code rather than redistributed, and on World Bank indicators. Includes the code, checks, summary tables and figures.

Code: MIT. World Bank data: CC BY 4.0. UN data are subject to the UN's terms of use and are not included.
